section.15: The Book of Shortening the Prayer When Traveling

15.name_native: The Book of Shortening the Prayer When Traveling

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:"Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, enjoined the prayer on the tongue of your Prophet (ﷺ): While a resident four (rak'ahs), while traveling two, and at times of fear one
